characters.name: The Wrigley Family
characters.media_title: Adventures of Pete and Pete, The
characters.description: The elder Pete is more stoic, as well as the one who tends to face the most "normal" challenges and moral quandaries of the two. He's somewhat insecure to boot. Bears AreGood News: Big Pete dresses up as one while working at his dad's golf course to avoid being embarrassed by his job. It results in a hunting tournament. Deadpan Snarker: Not so much in-series, but certainly in his episodic narrations. Drives Like CrazyMr. Slurm:(after getting out of the driving simulator with Pete) Congratulations, Mr. Wrigley. You're dead. Girl of the Week: He had a lot in season three.

characters.name: Friends
characters.media_title: Adventures of Pete and Pete, The
characters.description: Big Pete's best friend besides his brother. She has a type-A personality and can easily lose herself in a new project or cause. Ellen is also both the most likely to support Big Pete and the most likely tocall him out when he's being a jerk. The B Grade: She freaks out when she earns a C on a homework assignment. Everybody Hates Mathematics: Until she gets her teacher to include practical applications. Fleeting Passionate Hobbies: Varies from episode to episode, be it woodshop, vending machine repair, or playing in the school band. And extra emphasis on thepassionatepart. Hidden Depths: Her extensive knowledge of wrestling tactics, learned from her champion uncle.

characters.name: Villains
characters.media_title: Adventures of Pete and Pete, The
characters.description: He's older than the bully villains and thus better at subtlety, deception, sabotage, etc., but younger than the IAC (see below) and thus still willing to be openly violent. Arch-Enemy: To Big Pete Book Dumb: One of the theories for the source of his nickname is that he can't manage to graduate. Meaningful Name: HellstromSubverted by "Endless", though, because—in direct contrast to every other kid bad guy—the nickname has no apparent meaning and it's never explained why he has it. Fans have theorized that it's because he's endlessly repeating high school or because his hatred of Big Pete is endless (Nickelodeon Magazineposited the latter). characters.name: Other
characters.media_title: Adventures of Pete and Pete, The
characters.description: Bus driver, friend, basket case. Berserk Button: The song "If You're Happy and You Know It" Butt-Monkey: The most emotionally-crushing event possible will almost always be what happens to Stu on any given occasion. Love Makes You Crazy: His lowest moments stem from arguments with his girlfriend. Reasonable Authority Figure: Relative to the norm in Wellsville, that is.
